nearest_prior_results: Anand, Gupta, Jayaram, Lee and Vakilian, Approximating Minimum Spanning Trees in Metrics under Semi-Random Corruptions, arXiv:2610.40594v1 (29 October 2026), Definitions 2.1-2.3 and Theorems 1.4/5.3: no-query expected O_p(log n) general-corruption approximation for p<1/4; primary record https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40594 and full text https://arxiv.org/html/2610.40594v1 checked 2 November 2026 UTC.

Same source, Lemma 3.2: all-unmarked low-expected-cost repair benchmark; Lemma 5.6: transfer from almost-domination using a common-neighbor charging argument requiring 2p+2epsilon<1/2. These are credited antecedents, not new results of this candidate.

Same source, Theorem 1.5: linear expected-cost impossibility at p>=1/2; the displayed pseudometric example has the standard strictly positive regularization reconstructed in audit/math.md. No new lower bound is claimed.

Bateni, Dharangutte, Jayaram and Wang, Metric Clustering and MST with Strong and Weak Distance Oracles, COLT 2024, PMLR 247:498-550, Theorem 4: O(sqrt(log n)) without strong queries when observations remain metric; Appendix F.2.2/Theorem 32: logarithmic approximation obstruction at corruption probability 1/3. Official record https://proceedings.mlr.press/v247/bateni24a.html and official full text checked 2 November 2026 UTC.
substantive_delta: Proves the complete frozen affirmative statement for every fixed p<1/2 in the same unrestricted omniscient semi-random model. The new deterministic rectangle-density transfer theorem gives true ordered-path cost at most (320r/eta)W+(8r/eta)MST(d) for every metric and nonnegative weighted order. A uniformly feasible observable rectangle certificate composes this with the credited repair benchmark to give an explicit finite no-query O_p(log n) expected approximation throughout the previously uncovered interval.
why_nonroutine: The prior common-neighbor charging contradiction uses a good-pair fraction above one half and does not extend by parameter substitution. The candidate only needs positive density in every large rectangle: shorter overlapping metric edges yield a star with small true leaf diameter; each longer matching edge then contributes an endpoint with no leaf neighbor, forming a forbidden empty rectangle. One integral over all interval lengths avoids a second logarithm and arbitrary-aspect-ratio losses. This is a substantive new geometric implication, not an elementary corollary of the verified prior theorem or a restricted diagnostic.
significance: Resolves the entire information-theoretic corruption-threshold gap for a central metric optimization problem, matching the half-corruption boundary of the prior linear obstruction while preserving the logarithmic approximation objective and full adversarial model. At p=1/3 it also attains the order of the COLT 2024 logarithmic obstruction. The standalone metric transfer is a potential reusable tool, although applications beyond MST and efficient implementations are not proved. This is substantive mathematical value, separately classified working_paper for venue readiness.
